map.📚 深度解析：IBNR 估算（终极×未付比例）: 📚 Deep Dive: IBNR Estimation (Ultimate × Unpaid Ratio)
map.由终极赔款乘未付比例估已发生未报案准备金。: Estimate the IBNR reserve as ultimate loss times the unpaid ratio.
map.IBNR = 100000×(1−0.7) = 30000。即尚待发生/未报约: IBNR = 100000×(1−0.7) = 30000. That is, about 30k remains to occur / unreported.
map.已付比例高说明什么？: What does a high paid ratio indicate?
map.已付 70% 说明理赔较成熟，IBNR 仅剩 30%；早期业务已付低 IBNR: Paid 70% means claims are mature, with only 30% IBNR left; early-stage business with low paid has a large IBNR share and high uncertainty.
map.用已付比例估 IBNR 会低估吗？: Does estimating IBNR by paid ratio understate it?
map.会。已付比例高仅代表钱付得快，未报案案件（reporting lag）仍可能大量: Yes. A high paid ratio only means money is paid fast; unreported claims (reporting lag) may still be substantial. A safer approach uses the reported ratio or chain-ladder to estimate both IBNR and reported-unpaid together.
map.IBNR 准备金（本页代码口径，已付按 0–1 比例直接输入而非金额）：IBNR: IBNR reserve (code basis on this page, paid amount entered directly as a 0–1 ratio rather than an amount): IBNR = ultimate claims × (1 − paid ratio) (CNY); linked values: paid claims = ultimate claims × paid ratio (CNY), paid ratio (%) = ratio × 100, original ultimate claims (CNY). Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0. Rule: no fixed grading; a paid ratio of 0.7 means 70% settled and IBNR takes the remaining 30% of ultimate claims, and the closer the ratio is to 1 the smaller the outstanding liability.
map.总未付赔款准备金=终极赔款×(1−已付比例)（元）；纯 IBNR=总未付−已报未: Total unpaid claim reserve = ultimate claims × (1 − paid ratio) (CNY); pure IBNR = total unpaid − reported outstanding reserve (CNY, not below 0). Paid claims = ultimate claims × paid ratio; paid ratio (%) = ratio × 100. Blank reported outstanding is treated as 0. A paid ratio of 0.7 means 70% settled, with 30% total unpaid; pure IBNR is the “incurred but not reported” part after subtracting reported outstanding.
map.输入终极赔款、已付比例与已报未结准备金，分别求总未付赔款与纯 IBNR。: Enter ultimate claims, paid ratio, and reported outstanding reserve to compute total unpaid claims and pure IBNR.
map.未决赔款 = 终极赔款 × (1 − 已付比例)，已付比例由进展因子推算: Outstanding claims = ultimate claims × (1 − paid ratio); the paid ratio is derived from development factors
map.进展因子取各事故年相邻进展期累计已付赔款的比值，多期常取加权平均: A development factor is the ratio of cumulative paid claims between adjacent development periods for each accident year; multi-period values are often weighted averages
map.B-F 估计 = 终极赔款 × 未报案比例，用先验终极值替代已报案进展，降低低进: B-F estimate = ultimate claims × unreported ratio; it replaces reported development with a prior ultimate and reduces volatility in early development periods
